name: modsearch
description: Find a module by what you mean. Semantic search over the module fleet (or any docs you send): LiquidAI/LFM2.5-Embedding-350M running server-side in the liquidai module (own process, never evicts its chat model), falling back to an in-process all-MiniLM-L6-v2, fused with BM25. Every mod gets its own embedding hash (sha256 of model + kind + float16 vector) kept in an index. No key, no cloud. Powers the build hub's agent search and serves raw vectors (POST /embed).

search.docs: GET ?q=&k= ranks this box's fleet; POST {query, docs:[{id,text,name?}], k} ranks the docs you send -> {mode, model, backend, results:[{id,score,sem,lex,why,hash,text_hash}]}

embed.docs: {texts:[...<=512], backend:minilm|liquid|auto, kind:query|document} -> {model, dim, vectors} unit vectors, uncached; default minilm (x402's stored index is MiniLM)

mods.docs: Every fleet mod's text_hash + embedding_hash, model, dim; /mods/{name}?vector=1 adds the vector

reindex.docs: Re-read the fleet and re-hash changed mods (also runs every 10 min)
